$comment: A relationship candidate retained as unresolved evidence because no current ASA Relationship Type role authority exists to validate it (17th2nd/ASA#29). Its participants are bound to persistent UAO identities where the Foundry can resolve them. Identity binding and type-role authority are separable concerns: resolving cid-x to uao-y is an identity operation needing no ASA#29 authority, whereas validating that 'container' is a legal role of asa.core/contains@1 does. Binding improves the evidence quality of a retained candidate without moving it one step closer to canonical URO publication.
title: UAO Foundry Unresolved Relationship Candidate

typeVersion.$comment: Extension seam for ASA#29. When a governed Relationship Type registry exists, this is the key against which role names, cardinality, permitted participant kinds, identity-bearing flags, symmetry and ordering would be validated. The Foundry records it and validates nothing about it.

role.$comment: Recorded verbatim. Whether this is a legal role of the declared type is exactly what ASA#29 blocks the Foundry from knowing.

uaoId.$comment: Present only when binding is RESOLVED. An unresolvable participant must never be given a uid to make the relation look complete.

identityBindingStatus.$comment: ALL_PARTICIPANTS_BOUND does not mean the relationship is publishable. It means the identity half of the problem is solved and only the ASA#29 type-role half remains.
